Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month

Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6) • Install: Hospital

An extra block of batteries and cables recycles overflow to capacitors.

Iconic Internal Body Cyberware. Requires Interface Plug/Personal Link with the Feedback Circuit Enhancement. While the user is connected properly to any weapon with a Tech Rebuild via an Interface Plug/Personal Link and successfully hits an enemy with a charged Tech Rebuild, at the start of their next Turn they can charge the connected Tech Rebuild by sacrificing only their MOVE. If the weapon can already be charged with only half MOVE, then it can instead now be charged without sacrificing a Move Action whatsoever.

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Type: Internal Body Cyberware
Install: Hospital
Option Slots: uses 0

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Cyberware).
